english.note: Use this when something is quietly slipped or tucked into a place, including an unobtrusive insertion into text.

examples.english: I quietly slide an extra sentence into the article while nobody is paying attention.
examples.traditional: 我趁冇人留意，將一句補充攝入去篇文度。
